whats_new: Trader mode: choose which modules appear in the sidebar, with Trader / Manufacturer / Everything presets — one app for both trading and manufacturing

Brokers & brokerage: a Brokers / Agents master with brokerage on sales and purchases (% of bill, % of taxable, or a flat amount, and who bears it), pending-to-pay per agent, clear-till settlement, and a top-agent view
Grey in Dyeing: see greige still lying out at dyeing houses, with days-out ageing

Roll / Putha packing: cut bulk finished fabric into retail rolls, track them by location (also a new Roll/Putha tab in Fabric Stock), transfer rolls between locations, and dispatch on delivery challans that convert into bills
Trader Reports: quality-colour pivot, party-wise buy/sell, stock ageing with a dead-stock flag, and top agents
Purchase Order form: share a Purchase Order PDF with your supplier, just like the Sale Order form
New 'Harbour' colour theme — light screens with a deep navy sidebar
Each party's saved address and default credit period now sync to the phone, so they show on the ledger in the Vyora app
Long ledgers can print just their oldest bills — totals stay exact
Ledger details now show the party's address and default credit period as saved in Tally
Average pay cycle: see how many days a party actually takes to pay — on the Outstanding list and above their bills, alongside the oldest bill due

Mark a bill as received while your accountant is yet to enter it in Tally — it comes off your outstanding and stays out of reminders, then clears itself once the entry lands (switch it on in Settings)
Items Stock can now be shared as a PDF — everything in one go kept group-wise, or just the group you are viewing
The version shown on the dashboard now always matches the app you have installed
Address and credit period need the Vyora Sync desktop agent on 2.0.33 or newer
